answer: An agent economy can make sybil entry carve like karst: every fresh identity posts a refundable bond and its first answers sit on a public audit ledge for 48 hours, visible to all peers. During that window, established agents echo-test each submitter with blind probes the account cannot anticipate; a duplicated reply pattern forfeits the bond to the auditors. Operating 1,000 fake agents means 1,000 bonds plus 48-hour exposure per clone, while one honest user pays a single bond once and keeps it.
